title: March of the Restless Dead vs Golden Tumen
lede:
The Golden Tumen won 36-13 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 4, completing all four of its secondaries and taking its Primary to the 10 VP cap.

What decided it was LEAD FROM THE FRONT: the Tumen's four CHARACTERs all ride with squads, each joined pair counts twice, so the card paid 3 VP in each of the first three rounds while the March's BLEED THEM WHITE never paid at all.
result_line: Golden Tumen win 36-13 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The March of the Restless Dead set up on rows 12 and 13 in front of its HQ at (7,13): the Akhguard with the Canopic Priest and the Sphinx Construct on the left at (3,12) and (3,13), Ramesses, the Eternal Pharaoh at (5,13), the two Skeletal Spearman and two Skeletal Archer squads across the middle, and the Firelake Warden on the right rear at (11,13). The Golden Tumen put all four CHARACTERs at the head of squads: Genghis Khan with Khesig Guards 1 at (9,2), the Stormlord with Khesig Guards 2 at (11,2), the Black Shaman with the Stormrider at (4,1); the three Tamga-Bound Troops squads stood on the left at (3,2), (4,2) and (6,2), and the Nerge Outriders on the right at (11,1). The March had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (10 to 11). The set-up gave the Tumen four fast character pairs for a Primary that scores CHARACTERs in Objective Areas, and gave the March its melee block on the left objective.

1.title: The Tumen ride straight onto two objectives

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BLEED THEM WHITE for the March, LEAD FROM THE FRONT for the Tumen. Secondaries kept: FORWARD PRESENCE and IRON GRIP. The March spent 2 of its 3 CP on Double Time for Skeletal Spearman 1, which the record prices at nothing; the Tumen kept their 4.

Everything advanced. Skeletal Archer 1 reached 8,8 in the centre's area and Skeletal Spearman 1 5,8. For the Tumen, Khesig Guards 2 with the Stormlord took the right objective at 13,6, the Nerge Outriders and Tamga-Bound Troops 1 and 3 closed on the centre at 7,6, 6,6 and 6,5, and Genghis Khan with Khesig Guards 1 came to 5,6.

The Firelake Warden's Soulfire Cannon put 8 into Tamga-Bound Troops 1 (20 to 12, four models). Genghis Khan's Skypiercer Great Bow answered with 3 on Skeletal Archer 2 and left it PARALYZED; Khesig Guards 1 added 2 to it and Khesig Guards 2 1 to Skeletal Spearman 1. The Tumen's attacks banked 5 Mana through THE BLOOD-SONG.

The March held the centre on OC 10 vs 9 (3 VP, Skeletal Archer 1); the Tumen the right on OC 8 vs 0 (2). LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3 for Khesig Guards 2 and the Stormlord, one joined pair counted as two. IRON GRIP completed, +2 VP and +1 CP. 3-7.

2.title: The Akhguard win the left, the Tumen take the centre

feed.text: The March spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition: a Skeletal Archer at 9,12. The Tumen, on 9 CP, bought Troop Requisition (3): Tamga-Bound Troops at 7,2, and Secure Objective (3) for Tamga-Bound Troops 1, which changed nothing. Secondaries kept: SECURE THE FLANKS and FOCUSED FIRE.

The Akhguard charged Tamga-Bound Troops 2 on the left objective. Skeletal Spearman 1 charged the Nerge Outriders and Tamga-Bound Troops 1 at the centre; both failed their Fall Back tests and broke away in disorder, the Outriders losing a model (2 HP) and the Troops one (3 HP). Khesig Guards 1 with Genghis Khan rode to 10,6 under Go to Ground (1 CP): the Skeletal Archers' Overwatch hit 6 from 30 dice for nothing. Ramesses' Overwatch with the Winged Disc of Behdet took 4 off Khesig Guards 2 and set it and the Stormlord BURNED. Tamga-Bound Troops 3 walked onto the centre at 8,7.

The Akhguard rolled 16 hits from 20 dice: 16 damage, Tamga-Bound Troops 2 from 20 to 4. Skeletal Archer 1 took 6 off Tamga-Bound Troops 3. The Firelake Warden used Sacred Recitation (+1 DMG, +1 AP) for 7 on the Stormrider (20 to 13), which used Ride-By Fire to reach 13,6. Four Tumen units shot Skeletal Spearman 2 (FOCUSED FIRE completed, +2 VP and +1 CP) and the Tumen held 10 Mana.
The Tumen took the centre on OC 8 vs 6 (3) and the right on OC 11 vs 5 (2); the March the left on OC 14 vs 2 (2). LEAD FROM THE FRONT 3. 5-17.

3.title: Genghis Khan's Countercharge pins Ramesses; Skeletal Spearman 1 falls

feed.text: The March spent 2 CP on Double Time for Skeletal Archer 2. Secondaries kept: FOCUSED FIRE and ASSASSINATION. Tamga-Bound Troops 2 failed its Morale Test and was SUPPRESSED.

Ramesses came up to 11,8. The Tumen's HQ answered Skeletal Spearman 2's charge with Countercharge (3 CP): Khesig Guards 1 with Genghis Khan cancelled it and charged Ramesses and Skeletal Spearman 2 from 12,7, on the right objective. Skeletal Spearman 1 charged Tamga-Bound Troops 3, which broke away to 9,5. Khesig Guards 2 with the Stormlord went to 7,6 and the Stormrider with the Black Shaman to 8,6: three character pairs now stood on objectives. The Nerge Outriders used Feigned Flight to drop back to 2,3.

Go to Ground (1 CP) on the Stormrider; Skeletal Archer 1 and the requisitioned Skeletal Archer still took 7 off it (13 to 6). Ramesses' 3+ Invulnerable Save turned away all four melee hits from Khesig Guards 1 and Genghis Khan, and his counterattack took 4 off Khesig Guards 1. The Nerge Outriders' Spot & Mark raised Skeletal Spearman 1 to MARKED and the requisitioned Tamga-Bound Troops shot it dead (7 hits from 10, 6 damage). The Akhguard finished Tamga-Bound Troops 2 and took ground to 0,6. One unit lost each, so BLEED THEM WHITE paid nothing.

The Tumen held the centre on OC 9 vs 0 (3) and the right on OC 9 vs 5 (2); the March the left on OC 14 vs 0 (2). LEAD FROM THE FRONT 3 (9 of 10). SECURE THE FLANKS completed for the March with the Akhguard at 0,6, +2 VP and +1 CP. 9-25.

4.title: The Firelake Warden is thrown at Genghis Khan

feed.text: A Skeletal Spearman returned through SOULBOUND LEGION (rolled 6) and ANUBIS' TOLL gave the March 4 Mana. The Tumen spent 6 CP: Troop Requisition (Tamga-Bound Troops at 5,2) and Secure Objective on the Stormlord, neither of which changed anything. Secondaries kept: INTO THE FRAY and LAST STAND; FOCUSED FIRE expired for the March.

Ramesses tried to leave Khesig Guards 1, failed his Fall Back test (needed 6, rolled 1) and broke away in disorder for 3 True Damage, to 14,7; Skeletal Spearman 2 lost two models the same way. The Akhguard charged the Stormrider and Black Shaman at 3,7: INTO THE FRAY, +2. Then the March's HQ spent 3 CP on Countercharge and sent the Firelake Warden from 11,13 to 11,8 into Genghis Khan and Khesig Guards 1. The Sphinx Construct charged the Nerge Outriders; Khesig Guards 2 with the Stormlord charged the returned Skeletal Spearman on the centre.

The Akhguard rolled 13 hits: Stormrider destroyed, the Black Shaman down to 2. Genghis Khan struck first and cut the Firelake Warden down with 4 hits for 8: Firelake Warden destroyed, and ASSASSINATION paid the Tumen 4. The Canopic Priest cast Endless Procession (3 Mana) and raised a Skeletal Archer at 2,6. The Skeletal Archers shot Tamga-Bound Troops 3 from 12 to 2, leaving it Below Half-Strength on the centre.

The Tumen kept the centre on OC 8 vs 6 (3); the March the left on OC 7 vs 0 (2); the right tied 9 vs 9 with Ramesses and Skeletal Spearman 2 now in it. LEAD FROM THE FRONT 1 (10 of 10) and LAST STAND, the centre held with Tamga-Bound Troops 3 Below Half-Strength in it, +3. 13-36, the Tumen past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Golden Tumen scored 15 VP from objectives, 10 from LEAD FROM THE FRONT and 11 from secondaries: IRON GRIP 2, FOCUSED FIRE 2, ASSASSINATION 4, LAST STAND 3, four kept and four completed. The March of the Restless Dead scored 9 from objectives, 0 from its Primary and 4 from secondaries (SECURE THE FLANKS and INTO THE FRAY). The 23 VP margin is almost all Primary and secondaries: on objectives alone the Tumen were 15-9. The fighting was not what lost it: the March dealt 86 damage to the Tumen's 44, and each side lost two units (30 RP of the Tumen's, 43 RP of the March's, most of it the Firelake Warden).

The Primaries were not an even draw. LEAD FROM THE FRONT counts a CHARACTER and the squad it has joined separately (the engine's filter says so: the CHARACTER counts on its own), so one joined pair on an objective already reaches the 3 VP tier, and the Tumen field four pairs. It paid 3, 3, 3 and the last 1. BLEED THEM WHITE needs more kills than losses in a round; the kills went 0-0, 0-0, 1-1 and 1-1, and it paid nothing.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Khesig Guards 2 with the Stormlord were the Tumen's scorers, 8.6 and 8.3 VP: they held the right in Rounds 1 and 2 and the centre in Rounds 3 and 4. Genghis Khan took 6.0 VP, 4.3 of it from ASSASSINATION. For the March the Akhguard did most: 29 damage, both its kills (Tamga-Bound Troops 2 and the Stormrider), the left objective, SECURE THE FLANKS and INTO THE FRAY, 4.7 VP. The Firelake Warden did 15 damage in its first two rounds. Ramesses, the Eternal Pharaoh did 8 damage for 75 RP and scored no VP; the 45 RP Sphinx Construct did no damage and shared the left objective with the Akhguard (2.7 VP).

{{chart:attrition}}

What the March could not do

It could not hold the centre after Round 1. Its centre pieces were 8 to 10 RP Skeletal squads against Tamga-Bound Troops and then two character pairs; Skeletal Spearman 1 was shot dead there in Round 3. FORWARD PRESENCE (a unit within 3 squares of the enemy HQ at 7,1) was never in reach, and FOCUSED FIRE expired: the March never had more than two units attack one target in an Action Phase.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 4, Countercharge on the Firelake Warden: the March's best gun (15 damage) was spent with 3 CP into melee against Genghis Khan, struck second and died without a blow, and its death paid the Tumen ASSASSINATION, 4 VP. The commands record prices the Countercharge at nothing.
  • The Tumen's 20 Mana: THE BLOOD-SONG gave the Tumen 5 Mana every round and they spent none. The Black Shaman, the only MAGIC_CASTER, never cast a chant; in Round 3 its best option was a cast on the Stormrider scored at 0.
  • Commands that bought nothing: the March's Round 1 Double Time (2 CP); the Tumen's two Secure Objectives and their Round 4 Troop Requisition (9 CP between them). The Tumen could afford it, with 18 CP gained to the March's 13.
  • Round 4, Ramesses' Fall Back: the Fall Back record calls it sound (3.99 expected melee damage against 10 HP), but the test needed a 6 and the failed break cost 3 True Damage. Landing on the right objective did tie it.

How sure: the Primary draw and the Tumen's character pairs account for most of the margin, and that is the army plus the card, not the AI. The Firelake Warden Countercharge was an AI choice and cost 4 VP, but the Tumen were 25-9 before it.

closing: The Golden Tumen put a CHARACTER on every objective it could reach and its Primary paid for each of them twice. The Restless Dead won their fights on the left, but their centre was too light to hold and their Primary never paid.
